info.name: Integration API - Consumer to Extole Audiences Rewards API

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by reward state(s). Repeat for multiple values (e.g. `EARNED`, `FULFILLED`).

params.name: reward_supplier_id
params.description: Filter by Extole reward supplier id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: partner_reward_supplier_id
params.description: Filter by partner-assigned reward supplier id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: person_id
params.description: Filter by Extole person id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: action_id
params.description: Filter by Extole action id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: root_event_id
params.description: Filter by root event id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: partner_reward_id
params.description: Filter by partner-assigned reward id(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: reward_type
params.description: Filter by reward type(s). Repeat for multiple values.

params.name: success_only
params.description: When true (default), include only rewards that were successfully fulfilled.

params.name: time_interval
params.description: ISO 8601 time interval to restrict results to a date range (e.g. `P30D` for last 30 days).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rewards to return. Defaults to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of rewards to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.
